narrative: Annual bank terms & conditions privacy policy update.

message.body: Notice of Privacy Policy Update: We updated our privacy policy in accordance with regulations. View the updated terms on www.apexbank.com/privacy

evidence.label: Official Bank Homepage
evidence.value: Homepage footer links to identical privacy document.

consequence_text.safe: You verified the privacy terms on the bank's official website.

teaching_point: Privacy updates pointing to main corporate domains are authentic.
